name: @barttech/app-ui
description: Shared brand-neutral app-shell UI for the Barttech estate (LeftNav, …) — mounted as a git submodule in each app that has an admin/dashboard shell. Source-only, no build step; consumers transpile the .tsx through their own Next build.

scripts.test: tsc --outDir .testbuild --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --types node contrast.ts contrast.test.ts && node --test ".testbuild/*.test.js"
